_comment: First-run defaults. Copied into the per-install stores (app-prompts.json) the first time the server finds one missing, then never read again — editing this changes what a NEW install starts with, not what an existing one has. Each shelf maps a prompt name to its text; an empty string is a named row waiting for wording. Each replacement names its prompt as Shelf/Name — the server resolves that to the prompt id and takes a text snapshot, so no id or wording is written twice. The Female rows embed [hair] and [outfit] on purpose, as the worked example of a prompt built from other prompts: pick one Female row and the shelves it names come with it.

Action.Selfie Pose: she smiles as she takes a selfie, holding her phone up at arm's length
Action.Swing for Ball: she swings a tennis racket at a green tennis ball
Action.Victory Pose: she raises one hand in a peace sign and grins

Expression.Cheerful: she is laughing, her eyes bright
Expression.Intense Concentration: she is focused, her brow furrowed in concentration
Expression.Playful: she pulls a playful face, sticking her tongue out

Female.Athletic: a gorgeous slender fit young adult woman with light tan skin and a toned, athletic build, [hair], [outfit]
Female.Casual: a relaxed adult woman with freckles and a warm smile, [hair], [outfit]
Female.Professional: a confident woman in her thirties, [hair], [outfit]

Hair.Brunette Ponytail: her brunette hair tied back in a ponytail with a ribbon
Hair.Short Black: short black hair in a neat bob

Male.Sitting: a man sits on a bench nearby
Male.Standing: a man stands nearby with his arms folded

Outfit.Athletic: wearing leggings, a running top and running shoes
Outfit.Professional Suit: wearing a tailored navy suit and a white blouse
Outfit.Sun Dress: wearing a light floral summer dress and sandals
Outfit.Tennis: wearing a white tennis dress, wristbands and tennis shoes

Scene.Library: inside a quiet library with wooden desks, tall bookshelves and people reading
Scene.Public Park: in a public park with trees, green grass and people walking their dogs
Scene.Tennis Court: on an outdoor tennis court with spectators watching from the bleachers
